name: Saed Yousef
title: Lead Developer | Backend Systems | Infrastructure & Automation
subtitle: I build reliable backend systems, integrations, automation, and technical foundations.
about: I've been working in software engineering for the past decade, mostly around backend systems, integrations, infrastructure, automation, and internal platforms.

My career started with building features and applications, but over time my work moved more toward system design, architecture, technical decision-making, and making systems easier to operate and maintain. I've worked on projects involving APIs, third-party integrations, deployment processes, cloud infrastructure, performance improvements, data flows, and automation between different systems.

Today I work as a Lead Developer, where I'm responsible for both technical direction and day-to-day engineering work. I'm still very close to the code and the systems we run. A normal week can include architecture discussions, reviewing technical decisions, debugging production issues, improving deployment workflows, planning integrations, supporting developers, and removing bottlenecks from the team's work.

I care a lot about building systems that are practical, reliable, and understandable. I prefer simple solutions that solve the real problem over complicated designs that look good only on paper. I also enjoy improving existing systems, especially when there is a chance to reduce manual work, automate repetitive processes, or make the development workflow smoother.

Most of my experience is around backend platforms, APIs, integrations, automation, scalability, infrastructure, and technical leadership. I enjoy working on problems where engineering has a direct impact on how the business operates.
I'm always open to connecting with people who work on software systems, automation, architecture, infrastructure, or engineering leadership.
